about_the_game:
Hatch from your capsule into a nightmare deep beneath the earth. BirdFlu is a horror puzzle-platformer set in Geno Solutions, an underground research facility consumed by failed experiments and the Avian Plague V.
Navigate decaying corridors, uncover hidden mysteries, and fight to reach the surface before becoming part of the horrors below.

Master survival through platforming mechanics: double jump across broken catwalks, climb ledges to escape danger, balancing across unstable pipes, wall climb to hidden paths, slide under collapsing debris, and ride ziplines through hazardous zones. Solve escape-room style puzzles, push objects onto pressure plates, and unlock portal doors powered by bio cores to progress deeper into the unknown.

But beware - grotesque creatures roam these halls. From swarms of feral chickens to towering monstrosities, every encounter tests your reflexes and resolve. Each step unravels secrets buried in darkness, where the line between science and nightmare has long since been erased.

Escape is not guaranteed. The deeper you go, the more the facility itself turns against you. Find the portals. Survive the hunt. Escape Geno Solutions. Escape the Bird Flu.

content_descriptors.notes: Implications of heavy medical drug use and it's side effects. Gorey scenes in the environment to setup for a psychological horror game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6300 or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Low Settings, 720p/1080p recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times
